definitions.gloss: visitor; caller; person who comes to call on someone
definitions.explanation: A person who comes to visit a place — typically a home, office, institution, or website. A formal-sounding word most often used in business, official, or written contexts; in everyday conversation, words like お{客|きゃく}さん are far more common.

examples.japanese: {来訪者|らいほうしゃ}を{受付|うけつけ}で{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: Check visitors in at the reception desk.

examples.japanese: {来訪者|らいほうしゃ}には{必|かなら}ず{名札|なふだ}をお{渡|わた}ししています。
examples.english: We always issue a name badge to visitors.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}、このサイトの{来訪者|らいほうしゃ}が{急激|きゅうげき}に{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Recently, visitors to this site have been increasing rapidly.

examples.japanese: {大統領|だいとうりょう}の{執務室|しつむしつ}には、{毎日|まいにち}{国内外|こくないがい}から{多|おお}くの{来訪者|らいほうしゃ}があり、{対応|たいおう}に{追|お}われている。
examples.english: The president's office has many visitors from Japan and abroad every day, and he is kept busy attending to them.

notes:
Composed of {来訪|らいほう} (visit, call) and {者|しゃ} (person). Literally "a person who comes to visit."

USAGE:
{来訪者|らいほうしゃ} is a fairly formal, written-sounding word. It appears frequently in:
- business and official contexts (building security, reception procedures, government offices)
- news and reports ("{来訪者|らいほうしゃ}の{数|かず}", number of visitors)
- web analytics — used for "visitors" to a website, though ユーザー or アクセス{数|すう} are also common

In everyday conversation, Japanese speakers rarely say {来訪者|らいほうしゃ}. Words like お{客|きゃく}さん (customer, guest) or just {人|ひと} are used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {来訪者|らいほうしゃ}を{迎|むか}える: to receive a visitor
- {来訪者|らいほうしゃ}の{受付|うけつけ}: reception of visitors
- {来訪者|らいほうしゃ}{名簿|めいぼ}: visitor log / register
- {来訪者|らいほうしゃ}{数|すう}: number of visitors
- {来訪者|らいほうしゃ}がある: to have a visitor / for a visitor to come

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}: visitor — very close synonym; slightly more active (the visitor is actively going to the place)
- お{客|きゃく}さん: guest, customer — everyday word
- {来客|らいきゃく}: caller, incoming guest (often in a business setting)
- {参観者|さんかんしゃ}: observer, visitor (to an event, class, or open house)
- ビジター: visitor — loanword, often used in sports and at hotels/clubs

REGISTER:
Formal, written. For conversation, prefer お{客|きゃく}さん or {来客|らいきゃく}.
